Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Jamal Murray?

Jamal Murray is 29 years old.

Where was Jamal Murray born?

Jamal Murray was born in Kitchener, Ontario.

When was Jamal Murray born?

Jamal Murray was born on February 23, 1997.

How tall is Jamal Murray?

Jamal Murray is 6-4 (193 cm) tall.

How much does Jamal Murray weigh?

Jamal Murray weighs 215 lbs (97 kg).

Is Jamal Murray in the Hall of Fame?

Jamal Murray is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Jamal Murray drafted?

Jamal Murray was drafted by Denver Nuggets, 1st round (7th pick, 7th overall), 2016 NBA Draft.

What position does Jamal Murray play?

Point Guard and Shooting Guard.

What is Jamal Murray's net worth?

Jamal Murray has made at least $219,157,806 playing professional basketball.

How much does Jamal Murray make?

Jamal Murray made $46,394,100 in 2026.

How many rings does Jamal Murray have?

Jamal Murray has won one championship.

What is Jamal Murray's Instagram account?

Jamal Murray is on Instagram at jmglitxh27.

What schools did Jamal Murray attend?

Jamal Murray attended Orangeville Prep in Mono, Canada and Kentucky.

What are Jamal Murray's nicknames?

Blue Arrow, Glitch, Maple Curry are nicknames for Jamal Murray.
